resources.string: Connect your inbox to automatically import invoice PDFs. Opt-in only — you can disconnect at any time.
Your emails are never sent to jInvoice servers. PDFs are downloaded directly to your device and processed on-device only.
jInvoice will access your %1$s inbox to find and download invoice PDFs. Before you continue, please read and confirm each of the following disclosures.
jInvoice will scan email subject lines to identify invoices and receipts.
Matching PDF attachments will be downloaded directly to your device (Downloads/jInvoice/).
All processing happens on your device. No email content or attachments are sent to jInvoice servers.
Your OAuth token is stored only on this device in encrypted storage. You can revoke access at any time from Settings.
